intro: Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones are durable skeletal trophies gathered from the renegade Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands. Required by armor crafter Velora Nitely in the Undercity, they serve as reinforcement struts for bespoke warrior armor.

p: When forging brutal leg guards for frontline warriors, smiths require raw components that can endure severe punishment. In the Undercity, Velora Nitely prizes the skeletal density of the renegade Dragonmaw orcs entrenched at the Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands. Dragonmaw orcs are known for their thick, sturdy frames, making their shins well suited to serve as structural bracers. However, not every collected bone can withstand the strain; warriors must test each piece with their bare hands, discarding those that snap under pressure.
